title: Direct land / negative gates (tmux, fake forge, level a): under lone_pr_land = direct the rendered synthesizer brief lands exactly one ready PR without update-branch or a one-member train, trains two or more, and checks default-branch CI at the exact merge SHA; a lone ready PR behind main passes every scripted gate and squashes on the moved main with no update-branch and no train PR; two ready PRs land through a train; each unsatisfied §7 gate (stale or failed verdict, a changes verdict, red/pending/missing CI, missing proof, hold label, hold-until, rereview, escalation, sensitive or spec without merge-ok, no permission, mirror hold, draft, wrong base, unmergeable, closed, unreadable ownership) blocks crew train check, and the land-time subset stops crew train land with nothing squashed; a head moved after the check is refused at the forge and its old verdict does not carry

steps.run:
C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; L={state_dir}/gh.log; O={state_dir}/../origin.git; R={state_dir}/../repo; F={source}/dev/tests/scripts/fixtures/campaign; PATH=$F/a14:$PATH; T="--grace 0 --interval 0 --timeout 10"; V="python3 $F/a15/view.py"; Q="-R campaign/sandbox-{run_id}"
g() { git -C $R -c user.name=c -c user.email=c@x "$@"; }; tip() { git -C $O rev-parse ${1:-main}; }; h() { tip refs/pull/$1/head; }
pr() { g checkout -q -B b$1 $2 && (cd $R && sh -c "$3") && g add -A . && g commit -qm "feat: $1" -m "Engine: claude-code opus medium" && g push -q -f origin HEAD:refs/pull/$1/head HEAD:refs/heads/builder/$1-x && g checkout -q --detach; }
ok() { out=$($C train check $1 $P $X); rc=$?; echo "$out" | grep "status=blocked"; test $rc = 0 && echo "pr=$1 scripted gates pass ($(echo "$out" | grep -c status=manual) manual)"; }
miss() { n=$1 w=$2; shift 2; $V $n $(h $n) "$@" && out=$($C train check $n $P $X); rc=$?; echo "miss [$*] exit $rc: $(echo "$out" | grep -v "status=pass\|status=manual" | sed "s/^gate pr=[0-9]* sha=[0-9a-f]* //" | tr '\n' ' ')"; test $rc = 1 && echo "$out" | grep -q -- "$w"; }
train() { $V $1 $(h $1) && b=$($C train build $1 $P $T) && echo "$b" | sed -n "s/^train n=\([0-9]*\) .*ci=pass$/\1/p" | grep .; }
stop() { n=$1 w=$2; shift 2; k=$(train $n) || return 1; $V $n $(h $n) "$@"; m=$(tip); out=$($C train land $k $n $P $T $X); echo "land [$*] train $k: $(echo "$out" | grep "^stopped\|^crew:\|^landed" | sed 's/[0-9a-f]\{30\}\([0-9a-f]\{10\}\)/\1/g')"; test "$(tip)" = $m && ! grep -q "^pr merge $n " $L && echo "$out" | grep -q -- "$w"; }
B=$(cat $G/base); H=$(h 8); ok 8 || exit 1
miss 8 'name=verdict status=blocked' verdict=$B || exit 1
miss 8 'name=verdict status=blocked' validate=fail || exit 1
miss 8 'reason="no approval verdict at head"' "review=CHANGES_REQUESTED|<!-- crew:v1 role=reviewer-validator pass=verdict pr=8 sha=$H base=$B round=2 verdict=changes -->" || exit 1
miss 8 'name=ci status=blocked reason="checks failed"' ci=FAILURE || exit 1
miss 8 'name=ci status=blocked reason="checks pending"' ci=PENDING || exit 1
miss 8 'name=ci status=blocked reason="checks pending"' ci=none || exit 1
miss 8 'name=evidence status=blocked' "body=## Testing Done" || exit 1
miss 8 'reason="state tag crew:hold"' label=crew:hold || exit 1
miss 8 'reason="state tag crew:escalated"' label=crew:escalated || exit 1
miss 8 'reason="open rereview at head"' "review=COMMENTED|<!-- crew:v1 role=coordinator pass=steer cmd=rereview pr=8 sha=$H -->" || exit 1
miss 8 'reason="open coordinator hold-until-#30"' "comment=[Ash/hold] hold-until-#30 <!-- crew:v1 role=coordinator pass=steer cmd=hold pr=8 sha=$H -->" || exit 1
miss 8 'name=sensitive status=blocked' label=crew:sensitive ok=$B || exit 1
miss 8 'merge_grant_scope does not cover spec' label=crew:spec ok=none || exit 1
miss 8 'no merge-ok at head and merge_grant is none' ok=$B || exit 1
miss 8 'name=mirror status=blocked' label=crew:needs-mirror || exit 1
miss 8 'name=change status=blocked' draft || exit 1
miss 8 'name=change status=blocked' base=dev || exit 1
miss 8 'reason="not mergeable: GitHub reports CONFLICTING"' mergeable=CONFLICTING || exit 1
echo '{"issues/1/comments": "garbage"}' > $G/api.json; X="--org-profile {state_dir}/own.toml"
miss 8 'ownership: read-only; refusing' || exit 1
rm $G/api.json; X=; $V 8 $H && ok 8
